note: An upload made visible to what runs after it (register decision 272). Each mutant takes one of the three additions away: the barrier after the staging copy, the flush after the direct write, the flush of the staging buffer. **All three are declared survivors, for two reasons in turn.** At M1-107's commit nothing calls uploadBuffer -- it has existed since milestone 0 and M1-18's lambert probes are its first caller -- so no judge can reach them. And once M1-18 lands they still cannot be seen on this machine: its upload memory is host-coherent, where a flush does nothing, and the validation layers treat a host fence wait as completing everything before it, so a missing barrier draws the same frame. The owner chose the fix knowing it could not be shown failing here (2026-10-03). M1-18's pass re-runs this file with the lambert probes' tests as judges and records what they make of it.

mutants.name: the staging copy is never made visible to later commands
mutants.why: The barrier the specification asks for between the copy and any later read (chapters/synchronization.adoc: a fence signal's second access scope is empty, and a queue submission orders only earlier host writes). Nothing calls uploadBuffer before M1-18, and the validation layers cannot see a missing barrier across a host fence wait. Declared with the fix (register decision 272).

mutants.name: a write through a mapping is not flushed
mutants.why: The flush matters only on memory that is not host-coherent, and nothing calls uploadBuffer before M1-18. Declared with the fix (register decision 272). **Since M1-19 (2026-10-04) one mutant for both of the original two flushes**: the direct write's and the staging buffer's each go through VulkanContext::writeMapped, which copies and flushes in one place (register decision 284), so removing its flush removes both, and the second mutant -- 'the staging buffer is not flushed before the copy' -- would have been this one under another name. Merged by the owner's ruling. Still a survivor on the RX 7900 XTX: its host-visible memory measured DEVICE_LOCAL | HOST_VISIBLE | HOST_COHERENT (0x7) on 2026-10-04.
